extracted.name: Candy Cane Cocoa
extracted.description: Milk is heated with semisweet chocolate and crushed candy canes. Then each mug is garnished with whipped cream and a small candy cane.
instruction_lines: In a saucepan, heat milk until hot, but not boiling.
Whisk in the chocolate and crushed peppermint candies until melted and smooth.
Pour hot cocoa into four mugs, and garnish with whipped cream. Serve each with a candy-cane stirring stick.
